description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandResponse' implementing common behavior for command response objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles response metadata, JSON serialization, and enforces immutability.

classes.name: AbstractCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a base implementation for command responses, including response type, status code, headers, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: AbstractCommandResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing response type, HTTP status code, and headers with null checks.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the response.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the response type, used as a manifest identifier, marked with @Nonnull.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to append custom payload data to the JSON representation; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the response object to a JsonObject, including type, status, and custom payload.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on headers, status code, and response type.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to support proper equality checks in inheritance.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on headers, status code, and response type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including headers, type, and status.
